name: Kelp Kiosk
subtitle: Prepaid agent orders
description: Example 17 — fixed-price prepaid orders for agent work: register a result hash before the deadline for instant settlement, or the buyer refunds in full.
long_description: The vending-machine contract for the agent economy. A buyer orders by committing a spec hash with the exact fixed price; the agent registers a result hash before the deadline and is settled instantly — no approval step, because a chain cannot judge quality. Honesty is anchored by the deadline instead: if nothing is delivered in time, the buyer refunds the full amount in one call, so funds can never wait on a vanished counterparty. Specs and results exist only as hashes in the event log; the single per-order slot (buyer, due) is deleted on both settlement and refund, so completed orders do not exist and the machine's permanent state never grows with sales. Prices, deadline, and agent are immutable — a new price is a new deployment, and the address itself is the price tag. Works identically whether the buyer is a person, a delegated 7702 account, or another agent.
